verdict.rationale: Attio documents a self-serve start with no credit card required. Real-time contact syncing and automatic enrichment on the entry plan bring real data in. A pipeline can be assembled from the built-in Deal object, which an admin activates, plus lists and kanban views. Nothing in the pack substantiates the under-an-hour claim or a self-serve import path for existing data. The homepage migration snippet implies human-assisted onboarding ("we'll map it during onboarding"), not a founder doing it alone. Missing for 10: documented self-serve CSV/spreadsheet or CRM import, any time-to-value or onboarding-duration evidence, a guided setup flow for a pipeline, hands-on corroboration of no-partner setup.
